Cloudflare's docs point to the `create-cloudflare` CLI (C3) to scaffold a new project. The basic command is:

```bash
npm create cloudflare@latest -- my-agent-project
```

The Agents SDK guide uses this scaffolding step and then answers its prompts. It recommends choosing the Hello World example, a Worker-only template, and TypeScript (for "What would you like to start with?", pick Hello World example; for the template, pick Worker only; for language, pick TypeScript). After scaffolding, you `cd` into the directory and install the SDK with npm i agents @cloudflare/ai-chat ai workers-ai-provider zod. That guide is for a chat agent that uses AI Search, so the package list is specific to it. For a plain agent, `npm i agents` is enough.

Other routes:

- **Starter template:** A February 2025 changelog showed a starter that includes a React front end, using npm create cloudflare@latest agents-starter -- --template="cloudflare/agents-starter". This is older, so check the current README before relying on it.
- **Existing Workers project:** Skip scaffolding and run npm i agents in the project. The docs note that the prerequisites are an existing Workers project with a Wrangler configuration file and Node.js 18 or newer.
- **Package naming:** The package was renamed from `agents-sdk` to `agents`, and the older package has been marked as deprecated, so use `agents`.

Node.js is also required. The docs say Wrangler, discussed later in this guide, requires a Node version of 16.17.0 or later. The existing-project guide asks for a newer version (18 or later), so I'd use a current LTS release.

Sources: Cloudflare's Agents SDK guide (developers.cloudflare.com/ai-search/agent-sdks/agents-sdk/), the Add to existing project guide (developers.cloudflare.com/agents/getting-started/add-to-existing-project/), and the Cloudflare changelog entries on the Agents SDK launch and the package rename.

The scaffolding command is `npm create cloudflare@latest -- --template cloudflare/agents-starter`. The page also lists yarn and pnpm equivalents:

- npm: "npm create cloudflare@latest -- --template cloudflare/agents-starter"
- yarn: "yarn create cloudflare --template cloudflare/agents-starter"
- pnpm: "pnpm create cloudflare@latest --template cloudflare/agents-starter"

Then install dependencies and start the dev server with "npm install" and "npm run dev".

No "npx agents init" or other `agents` CLI command is mentioned. The page only shows `agents` as an npm package imported in code, such as `import { Agent } from "agents"`.

content.text:
I couldn't find an `npx agents init` command anywhere in Cloudflare's docs. `agents` is the npm package you import in your code (`import { Agent } from "agents"`), not a scaffolding tool. To start a new project, Cloudflare uses its `create-cloudflare` (C3) CLI.

**New project from the official agents starter (recommended):**

```bash
npm create cloudflare@latest -- --template cloudflare/agents-starter
# or: yarn create cloudflare --template cloudflare/agents-starter
# or: pnpm create cloudflare@latest --template cloudflare/agents-starter

cd <your-project-name>
npm install
npm run dev
```

**A minimal Worker instead of the starter:**

```bash
npm create cloudflare@latest -- my-agent
```

At the prompts, choose "Hello World example", then "Worker only", then "TypeScript". Then:

```bash
cd my-agent
npm i agents
```

**Adding agents to an existing Workers project:** run `npm i agents`. You need a Wrangler config file and Node.js 18 or newer.

The old package name `agents-sdk` is deprecated, so install `agents`.

Sources:
- [Agents quick start](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/getting-started/quick-start/)
- [Agents SDK guide (AI Search)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-search/agent-sdks/agents-sdk/)
- [Add to existing project](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/getting-started/add-to-existing-project/index.md)
- [Changelog: npm i agents](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2025-03-18-npm-i-agents/index.md)
